population: US civilian noninstitutionalized adults aged 18 and older
interpretation: Values describe reported disease history or the explicitly stated current/3-month outcome, not future 10-year incidence.
Diagnosed conditions are self-reported and do not capture all undiagnosed disease.
Joint condition estimates describe co-occurrence, not a causal effect or personal diagnosis.
Rows may use broader populations when the exact cell fails precision screening. Always render scope and fallback disclosure.
A present condition is reported as known_present, not another predicted diagnosis.
No cost estimates or exposure totals are included.
sources: 2024 National Health Interview Survey Sample Adult public-use data
2023 National Health Interview Survey Sample Adult public-use data

race_groups.label: Non-Hispanic American Indian/Alaska Native, alone or with another race
Non-Hispanic other single/multiple races, excluding the AIAN categories

obesity.label: Obesity (self-reported height/weight BMI >=30)
obesity.definition: BMICAT_A=4 is yes; 1,2,3 are no; 9 and missing are excluded. Uses the released BMI recode, not measured NHANES BMI.

hypertension.label: Ever diagnosed hypertension
hypertension.definition: HYPEV_A=1 is yes, HYPEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

high_cholesterol.label: Ever diagnosed high cholesterol
high_cholesterol.definition: CHLEV_A=1 is yes, CHLEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

arthritis_group.label: Ever diagnosed arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, lupus or fibromyalgia
arthritis_group.definition: ARTHEV_A=1 is yes, ARTHEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

depression.label: Ever diagnosed depression
depression.definition: DEPEV_A=1 is yes, DEPEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

anxiety_disorder.label: Ever diagnosed anxiety disorder
anxiety_disorder.definition: ANXEV_A=1 is yes, ANXEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

asthma_ever.label: Ever diagnosed asthma
asthma_ever.definition: ASEV_A=1 is yes, ASEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

cancer_ever.label: Ever diagnosed cancer or malignancy of any kind
cancer_ever.definition: CANEV_A=1 is yes, CANEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

type2_diabetes.label: Self-reported diagnosed type 2 diabetes
type2_diabetes.definition: DIBEV_A=1 and DIBTYPE_A=2 is yes. DIBEV_A=2, or DIBEV_A=1 and DIBTYPE_A in [1,3], is no. Unknown diabetes status or unknown type among diagnosed respondents is excluded; no imputation.

coronary_heart_disease.label: Ever diagnosed coronary heart disease
coronary_heart_disease.definition: CHDEV_A=1 is yes, CHDEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

stroke_ever.label: Ever diagnosed stroke
stroke_ever.definition: STREV_A=1 is yes, STREV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

weak_failing_kidneys.label: Ever diagnosed weak or failing kidneys
weak_failing_kidneys.definition: KIDWEAKEV_A=1 is yes, KIDWEAKEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

copd.label: Ever diagnosed COPD, emphysema or chronic bronchitis
copd.definition: COPDEV_A=1 is yes, COPDEV_A=2 is no; all other codes are missing.

chronic_pain.label: Chronic pain (most days or every day in past 3 months)
chronic_pain.definition: PAIFRQ3M_A in [3,4] is yes; [1,2] is no; [7,8,9] or missing excluded.
